segments.name: Broadcasting
segments.description: Owns and operates local television stations and digital assets serving US television households with news, entertainment and network programming.
segments.evidence: We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets in the United States.

segments.name: Production Companies
segments.description: Operates video production companies and studio production facilities producing content for various clients.
segments.evidence: Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue primarily from local, regional and national broadcast and digital advertising and from retransmission consent fees paid by MVPDs, plus lesser studio and tower rental fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Our operating revenues are derived primarily from broadcast and digital advertising and from retransmission consent fees.

changes.text: In 2025, the company changed its corporate name from Gray Television, Inc. to Gray Media, Inc.
changes.evidence: On January 1, 2025, we changed our corporate name from Gray Television, Inc. to Gray Media, Inc.
